candidates.change_summary: Replace the owner-only restriction on burn with no restriction so any caller can burn their own balance, changing totalSupply when non-owner burns.
Change the burn function to reduce totalSupply by twice the value burned, altering totalSupply after burn.
Change burn so it decrements totalSupply by zero (effectively not updating totalSupply), making totalSupply unchanged after burn.
Move the totalSupply decrement to occur before reducing the caller's balance, which could allow underflow checks to differ in behavior (state ordering change).
Modify onlyOwner helper to allow any caller (remove owner check), enabling burns by non-owners and thus changing totalSupply after such calls.
Removed the onlyOwner modifier requirement from burn so any caller can burn their own balance, altering balances after burn calls from non-owners.
Changed the state mutation to deduct the burned amount from the owner's balance instead of msg.sender, so balances differ after burn when called by non-owner.
Reversed the sign of balance update to increase the burner’s balance instead of decreasing it, causing balances to differ after burn calls.
Removed the line that reduces totalSupply so burning no longer decreases totalSupply, altering observable total supply and possibly balances indirectly.
Changed onlyOwner helper to allow any caller by removing the require, which can enable previously restricted calls (like burn) if modifier used; modifies control flow when modifier applied.
